newsitem.title: USA: TECNOL Medical expects very good year.
newsitem.headline: TECNOL Medical expects very good year.

text.p: TECNOL Medical Products Inc said Wednesday it maintained its growth momentum in the first quarter ended March 1 and expects a very good year in fiscal 1997.
The company reported 5.9 percent higher sales and a 13.6 percent increase in net income compared with the first quarter last year.
"These results are solidly in line with our plan for the year," said chief executive Van Hubbard. "Sales for February were particularly strong, and we're expecting a very good year in fiscal 1997.

"Sales growth in specialty masks was once again led by our PFR95 respirator mask line, which recorded its fifth consecutive quarter of improving sales. PFR95 sales were $1.7 million in the first quarter, a 58 percent increase over sales for the first quarter last year.

"We also reinforced this top-selling respirator line in the most recent quarter by launching the new PFR P1, a PFR95-type respirator that meets the specific filtration standards of the European market."
